volume.label: Volume
volume.def: Google's searches bucket for the trend (e.g. 200K+)

searches.label: Searches/mo
searches.def: Google Ads monthly searches, India, latest month Google has published (Aug 2026); '—' = not fetched or too new

growth.label: Growth
growth.def: Rise vs normal; Google caps it at +1,000%

states.label: States
states.def: State lists it is on, of 36

momentum.label: Δ Rank
momentum.def: Rank change since the last scan (≥3 places = up / down; NEW = not in the last scan)

phase.label: Phase
phase.def: Emerging / peaking / cooling from the 7-day curve, else from age within the type's typical window

signals.label: Signals
signals.def: Lights confirming the trend: Search, Breadth, News, Buzz, Wikipedia, Calendar; k of n known

why_now.label: Why now
why_now.def: Calendar event › headline class › Wikipedia spike

verdict.label: Verdict
verdict.def: First rule that matches: demand × where it streams

streams_on.label: Streams on
streams_on.def: Catalog › calendar › verified partner list › Wikidata › news (a headline is only a claim)

share_of_search.label: Share
share_of_search.def: A brand's average Google Trends index ÷ the sum over brands, India, past 90 days

gap_demand.label: Gap demand
gap_demand.def: Heat of entertainment titles not in the bundle ÷ heat of all entertainment titles

fixture_rank.label: Rank
fixture_rank.def: India playing first, then the competition tier (1 international cricket and multi-sport finals · 2 Indian leagues, Formula 1, international football, UEFA competitions · 3 other), then rights known, then the date. No score is computed — only these facts from the calendar row.

crossover.label: Crossover
crossover.def: On state lists of ≥ 2 language regions

attention.label: Wikipedia
attention.def: Daily views when the article was in India's top lists

attention_score.label: Attention
attention_score.def: Attention 0–100 = 40% Wikipedia views (7 d, 8 editions; English × 0.5; log scale 100 → 0, 1,000,000 → 100) + 10% rise vs the week before (+200% = 100) + 15% days on India's most-read list + 20% best Google Trending-now heat this week + 15% a release or match within 14 days. No figure = '—'.

status_7d.label: Status
status_7d.def: gone = not on the latest scan · new = only on the latest scan this week · rising / cooling = latest heat ≥ 5 points above / below its previous appearance · steady = otherwise

fixtures.rank_rule: India playing first, then the competition tier (1 international cricket and multi-sport finals · 2 Indian leagues, Formula 1, international football, UEFA competitions · 3 other), then rights known, then the date. No score is computed — only these facts from the calendar row.

gap_rules.rule: a film, series, show or match from the scans of the last N days whose availability is a rival or unknown (the board's own availability), finished matches left out (verdict 'Match over' or Skip, Google ended the trend, more than 24 h since it began, or not seen in any scan for 36 h); sorted by heat, then Google Ads searches
on Xstream or an Airtel partner / pack, with momentum up or new since the previous scan, or a 7-day curve that is emerging; finished matches and Skip verdicts left out
the heat of entertainment gap titles ÷ the heat of every entertainment title in the window × 100 (heat, not searches: heat exists for every trend)
the rival platform holding the most gap heat (rival-only titles)

unknown: — means the source has no figure; never 0
